# mathspp

> > A Python learning platform offering books, courses, trainings, and content on programming best practices, algorithms, and advanced iteration techniques.

mathspp is created by Rodrigo Girão Serração and provides comprehensive Python education through multiple formats including live cohort-based courses, corporate trainings, published books, and a content hub with blog articles, puzzles, and newsletters. The platform specializes in advanced Python concepts like itertools, generators, and functional programming patterns.

## Key Topics

- Python programming
- itertools
- Pydon'ts (Python best practices)
- Advanced iteration
- Generators and iterators
- Python training
- Algorithms
- Code snippets
- Live coding
- Python newsletter
- Rust for Python developers
- Python automation
- Mathematical problems
- Programming education
- Python 3.15

## Learning Programs

- [Courses](https://mathspp.com/courses): Cohort-based live courses: Intermediate Python and Algorithm Mastery bootcamp.
- [Trainings](https://mathspp.com/trainings): Corporate Python trainings: advanced iteration, scripting, Rust for developers.
- [Advanced Iteration Training](https://mathspp.com/trainings/advanced-iteration): 4-day advanced iteration course: generators, iterators, and itertools.
- [Python for Scripting and Automation](https://mathspp.com/trainings/python-for-scripting-and-automation): Python scripting and automation training: CLI tools, file manipulation, workflows.
- [Rust for Python Developers](https://mathspp.com/trainings/rust-for-python-developers): 4-day Rust course for Python developers: ownership, borrowing, interoperability.

## Content Hub

- [Blog](https://mathspp.com/blog): Blog hub covering Python, programming, mathematics, algorithms, and tutorials.
- [Pydon'ts](https://mathspp.com/blog/pydonts): Pydon'ts: Python best practices and tips for writing elegant, Pythonic code.
- [Problems](https://mathspp.com/blog/problems): Biweekly logic puzzles, math problems, and riddles for recreational mathematics.
- [Today I Learned (TIL)](https://mathspp.com/blog/til): Short articles documenting Python, mathematics, and programming discoveries.
- [Twitter Threads](https://mathspp.com/blog/twitter-threads): Unrolled Twitter threads on Python tutorials and programming tips.

## Newsletters

- [mathspp insider](https://mathspp.com/insider): mathspp insider newsletter: weekly Python deep-dives for skill advancement.
- [Python drops](https://mathspp.com/drops): Python drops newsletter: daily tips, flashcards, and code snippets.

## Books & Speaking

- [Books](https://mathspp.com/books): Published books: Pydon'ts and The Little Book of Itertools on Python.
- [Talks](https://mathspp.com/talks): Conference talks and public speaking appearances on Python and itertools.
